description: Visual CSS box-shadow builder with live preview.

faqs.a: Blur softens the shadow's edges, while spread expands or shrinks the shadow's size. A negative spread makes the shadow smaller than the box.
faqs.q: What is the difference between blur and spread?

faqs.a: The box-shadow property works in all modern browsers. Inset shadows are part of the same property, not a separate one.
faqs.q: Does box-shadow work in all browsers?

faqs.a: Yes — tick the inset checkbox and the shadow is drawn inside the element instead of outside.
faqs.q: Can I make an inner shadow?

howto: Drag the sliders to set the X/Y offset, blur and spread.
Pick a shadow color and optionally tick inset.
Watch the preview box update live.
Copy the generated CSS snippet into your stylesheet.
